title: Diamond Framework: Reputation-Weighted Validator Selection via Verifiable Non-Transferable Reputation
description: Paper and repository for the Diamond Framework, v0.2.0. Includes: the paper source and PDF (40 pp), a 38-script verification suite with byte-identical reruns, a falsification log (22 entries), an Avalanche Fuji phase-1 deployment with on-chain wiring verified, an 11-file anchor root, and OpenTimestamps receipts. Key updates since v0.1.0: R-7 (Fase 4: DEC-1 to DEC-5), R-8 (Fuji gas), R-9 (F-022 block time), R-10 (N-3, N-7, N-8 to N-15, M9 declared), R-11 (P0 pre-v0.2.0), plus session logs (SESSIONS.md + sessions/S-001 to S-012). Verification: 262 Foundry tests, 170 Rust tests (2 ignored), 11/11 audit gate. The anchor root covers eleven files; the recursion SNARK and Teleporter cross-subnet latency are declared deferred in Section 10. The repository code is MIT; the manuscript and frozen PDF are CC BY 4.0.
